verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Seated to one side, King Pasenadi said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “atthi nu kho, bhante, eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—
verses.english: “Sir, is there one thing that secures benefits for both
this life and lives to come?”

verses.pali: “Atthi kho, mahārāja, eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—
“Katamo pana, bhante, eko dhammo, yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—
“Appamādo kho, mahārāja, eko dhammo, yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—
verses.english: “Diligence, great king, is one thing that secures benefits for both
this life and lives to come.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, mahārāja, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṁ pāṇānaṁ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṁ gacchanti, hatthipadaṁ tesaṁ aggamakkhāyati—yadidaṁ mahantattena;
verses.english: The footprints of all creatures that walk can fit inside an elephant’s footprint. So an elephant’s footprint is said to be the biggest of them all.

verses.pali: evameva kho, mahārāja, appamādo eko dhammo, yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—
verses.english: In the same way, diligence is one thing that secures benefits for both
this life and lives to come.”
That is what the Buddha said. …
An attentive one, comprehending the meaning,
